presets.label: Light aircraft cruise
presets.prompt: Wing section for a light aircraft cruising at Mach 0.15 at sea level. Reynolds number 3 million, design lift coefficient 0.5. Maximise L/D at the design point, at least 12% thick, |Cm| no more than 0.10, target L/D of at least 50.

presets.label: Endurance UAV loiter
presets.prompt: Loiter condition for a long-endurance UAV at 2,000 m: Mach 0.08, density 1.007 kg/m3, Reynolds number 1.2 million, design lift coefficient 0.8. Maximise endurance (Cl^1.5/Cd). Minimum thickness 12%.

presets.label: Trainer climb
presets.prompt: Climb segment of a trainer: Mach 0.12, sea-level density, Reynolds number 2 million, design lift coefficient 0.9. Lowest drag at that lift, 15% thick for spar depth.

presets.label: Fast cruise (Mach 0.35)
presets.prompt: Turboprop cruise at Mach 0.35 at 3,000 m (density 0.909 kg/m3), Reynolds number 6 million, design lift coefficient 0.35. Minimise drag; thickness at least 12%.
